run_inference_multiview: run inference on multiple images using a Fast3R model with automatic device and dtype handling
run_loss_of_one_batch: run a single batch through the model with autocast precision and optional profiling support
compute_pred_pts3d: compute predicted 3D points from depth maps or pseudo_focal with optional camera pose transformation
compute_opt_scaling: compute optimal scaling factor between ground truth and predicted point clouds using Weiszfeld or average methods
check_image_same_size: check if all images in a list have the same spatial dimensions for batching decisions
